def load_asset(key):

        with bpy.data.libraries.load(p, link=False) as (df, dt):

        for o in objs:

def dup_hierarchy(objs, root, name):
    """object-level copy (shared mesh/material data) of a loaded hierarchy under a new root"""
    new_root = empty(name + "_root")
    m = {}
    for o in objs:
        c = o.copy(); m[o] = c; link(c)
    for o, c in m.items():
        if o.parent in m: c.parent = m[o.parent]; c.matrix_parent_inverse = o.matrix_parent_inverse.copy()
        elif o.parent == root or o.parent is None: c.parent = new_root
        for md in c.modifiers:
            if md.type == "ARMATURE" and md.object in m: md.object = m[md.object]
    return new_root, list(m.values())

def fix_def_parents(arm):
    """rigify: DEF bones hang off ORG chains; re-parent them into one DEF hierarchy so FK posing propagates."""
    try:
        for o in bpy.context.view_layer.objects: o.select_set(False)
        arm.hide_viewport = False; arm.hide_set(False)
        bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = arm; arm.select_set(True)
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="EDIT")
        eb = arm.data.edit_bones; names = set(b.name for b in eb); n = 0
        for b in list(eb):
            if not b.name.startswith("DEF-"): continue
            par = b.parent
            if par is None or par.name.startswith("DEF-"): continue
            q = par; c = None
            while q is not None:
                cand = "DEF-" + q.name[4:] if q.name.startswith(("ORG-", "MCH-")) else ("DEF-" + q.name if ("DEF-" + q.name) in names else None)
                if cand and cand in names and cand != b.name: c = cand; break
                q = q.parent
            if c:
                b.use_connect = False; b.parent = eb[c]; n += 1
        bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="OBJECT")
        return n
    except Exception as e:
        try: bpy.ops.object.mode_set(mode="OBJECT")
        except Exception: pass
        NOTES.append("fixpar " + type(e).__name__ + str(e)[:40]); return -1

def pose_for(role, name, ph, t):
    P = RG
    if name == "DRIVE":
        p = P.DRIVE
        if role == "drv":
            if 0.5 <= t < 1.3:  # turns the key, double-take at the dash
                k = C.pulse(t, 0.5, 0.9)
                p = P.P(p, faR=(0.6 * k - 0.0, -1, 0.35 - 0.6 * k), head=(15 * C.pulse(t, 0.85, 1.25), 0, -25 * C.pulse(t, 0.85, 1.25)))
            if 19.92 <= t < 21.52:  # frozen, then panics
                p = P.P(p, head=(-6, 0, 0))
        return p
    if name == "SIT": return P.SIT
    if name == "EXIT":
        return RG.blend(P.P(P.SIT, spine=(25, 0, 0)), P.STARTLE, C.clamp(ph * 1.6)) if ph < 0.6 else RG.blend(P.STARTLE, P.run_pose(ph * 12, 0.6), C.clamp((ph - 0.6) * 2.5))
    if name == "LOOK":
        yaw = 0.0
        if ph < 0.6: yaw = 55 * C.ss(ph / 0.6)
        elif ph < 1.2: yaw = 55 - 110 * C.ss((ph - 0.6) / 0.6)
        else: yaw = -55 + 55 * C.ss((ph - 1.2) / 0.3)
        p = P.P(P.STAND, head=(0, 0, yaw), neck=(0, 0, yaw * 0.3))
        if ph > 1.35: p = RG.blend(p, P.SHRUG, C.ss((ph - 1.35) / 0.3))
        return p
    if name == "RUN": return P.run_pose(ph, 1.0)
    if name == "RUNFREEZE": return P.run_pose(ph, 1.0)
    if name == "STAND": return P.STAND
    if name == "THUMB": return RG.blend(P.STAND, P.THUMB, C.ramp(t, 36.48, 36.8))
    if name == "GHOST":
        if t < 35.42: return P.P(P.STAND, head=(0, 0, 0))
        return RG.blend(P.STARTLE, P.FACEPALM, C.ramp(t, 35.55, 35.85))
    if name == "PHONE":
        k = C.ramp(t, 45.25, 45.6)
        return RG.blend(P.STAND, P.PHONE, k)
    if name == "CAB":
        lean = C.ramp(t, 2.5, 2.95) if t < 10 else C.ramp(t, 52.3, 53.1)
        p = RG.blend(P.SIT, P.LEAN, lean)
        if 3.54 > t > 3.2: p = P.P(p, uaR=(-0.1, -0.9, -0.2), faR=(0.0, -0.2, -1))
        return p
    if name == "DESK":
        up = C.ramp(t, 48.3, 48.6)
        return RG.blend(P.P(P.SIT, spine=(20, 0, 0), head=(18, 0, 0)), P.P(P.SIT, spine=(-6, 0, 0), head=(-8, 0, 0), uaL=(0.4, -0.3, -1), uaR=(-0.4, -0.3, -1)), up)
    return P.STAND

    for j, s_ in enumerate(SPARKS):

    # balance scale
